name: Beams-TS-TW
blurb: Animated light beams sweep across the canvas in a radiating pattern.
description: Renders light beams using Three.js and WebGL. Beams sweep continuously with configurable count, color, speed, and noise distortion. Uses GLSL shaders for the beam effect.
use_when: Dramatic hero backgrounds, tech product showcases, energy/light-themed designs.
avoid_when: Mobile devices; high performance cost. Older browsers without WebGL support.
a11y: Purely decorative animation. Canvas has no aria attributes or keyboard interaction.
